title: Injectable and Retrievable Calcium Salicylate Hydrogel Promotes Sustained Periapical Bone Regeneration in a Beagle Dog Model of Apical Periodontitis
html: Persistent apical periodontitis remains a clinical challenge requiring both effective disinfection and bone regeneration. This study tested the hypothesis that an injectable, retrievable F127-dimethacrylamide (DMA)/calcium salicylate (CASA) hydrogel facilitates periapical bone healing by combining antimicrobial action with osteogenic induction.
